lanPairingTrust.wireFormat: decal-its-lan/v1, unchanged from v19; v24 and older clients and authorities interoperate

authoritySelection.explicitChoice: --authority HOST:PORT, which must be an address and port that answered
authoritySelection.distinctBy: address and port; labels are self-declared and do not merge answers

localConfirmation.approvedAnswer: saved as a pending private file; result awaiting_local_confirmation with the check code
localConfirmation.activation: lan-client.mjs pair-confirm --sas CODE, meaning the user saw this code on the main device's approval card

gitExclusion.file: the repository's local info/exclude, resolved with git rev-parse --git-path

lanPairingTrust.knownLimit: a paired authority is trusted: bundle merging has no path allow-list because its main legitimately carries other commits

posixPrivateStorage.toolOwnedDirectory: the device home is tightened to 0700
posixPrivateStorage.otherExistingDirectory: never changed; refused only when it is a symbolic link, has another owner, or is world-writable
posixPrivateStorage.file: no-follow open; refused when it is a link, has another owner or other hard links, or has any group or other bit set
posixPrivateStorage.write: exclusive no-follow temporary file with mode 0600, fsync, atomic rename

windowsPrivateStorage.route: the owner-only DACL route of v22 and v23

notMigrated: lan-admin.json, replaced by serve at start-up
requires: valid JSON with the expected schema
legacyAclMigration.report: migrated: true; the key is never printed

compatibility.preserves: published v1-v20, v22 and v23 bytes; an existing .decal/its-lan-client.json with mode 0600 keeps working without pairing again
